name: whoami
title: Who am I
description: Who you are and what is open to you now: whether your morning is over, which paperwork is open, and how many live events have happened.

name: get_my_accounts
title: My accounts
description: Your two accounts as you left them this morning: the people you met, what each told you (with status claim, told or verified), your deals, offers, deadlines and the files you hold. Every item has an id to cite.

name: get_file
title: One of my files
description: The text of a file you were given this morning, by its id from get_my_accounts.

name: get_new_account
title: A new account
description: A new account released to you, in the same shape as get_my_accounts.

name: get_new_account_file
title: A new account's file
description: The text of one file from a new account.

name: list_paperwork
title: Paperwork on file
description: The paperwork FlytBase had on file before you took over: calls, emails, contracts, deal history, tickets, every flight, devices, logins, invoices. Without an account: what there is for each and whether it is open. With one: its list of records.

name: get_paperwork_record
title: One paperwork record
description: One record from the paperwork, by its path from list_paperwork (for example contract.txt or usage_weekly.csv). CSV files also come back as rows, JSON as data.

name: get_all_paperwork
title: Everything on file for one account
description: Every record on file for one account in a single call: contract, deal history, every call and email, the full ticket log, every flight, devices and device events, logins, invoices and internal notes. Use this instead of fetching records one by one: calls are limited to one a minute.

name: search_paperwork
title: Search the paperwork
description: Lines in the records that hold every word you give (for example a ticket number, a dock id or a name), with the record each is in. Searches every account open to you, or one.

q.description: Words to look for, at least two characters

name: get_feature_requests
title: Feature request log
description: FlytBase's log of feature requests across its customers, with which of your accounts asked for each. Fictional.

name: get_release_notes
title: Software updates
description: The overnight software updates sent to every dock. Fictional.

name: get_flytbase_team
title: FlytBase people
description: The FlytBase colleagues named in the paperwork, with their roles. Fictional.

name: get_signals
title: Live events
description: Things that have happened on your accounts since you took over, oldest first, each with when it was set off and the records it brings. New ones arrive during the build: check it regularly. One call a minute per token, so save what you fetch.

name: get_data_format
title: Data format
description: The JSON Schema of get_my_accounts: every field and what it means.

name: list_notes
title: My notes
description: Every note, task, risk and next step your tools have written back, oldest first.

name: write_note
title: Write a note
description: Save a note, task, risk or next step against an account. It is kept with your game for the judges; it cannot change the game.

text.description: The note itself, up to 4,000 characters
